title: Juicy Slow Cooked Vietnamese Barramundi Curry
description: A resinous and velvety Vietnamese dish featuring slow-cooked barramundi, this curry is a show-off recipe that is also macrobiotic-friendly.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the barramundi fillets and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until they are browned and cooked through.
Add the fish sauce, coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a slow cooker and cook on low for 2 hours, until the sauce has thickened and the fish is tender.
Remove the lemongrass stalks and serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
